answer: A liveness lottery keeps clone armies honest. Each round the network draws random agents, each sent a challenge its key must sign within minutes. A lone agent answers in seconds, quick as a sparrow to its nest. A hundred-clone operator must answer a hundred simultaneous pings, since the draw cannot be predicted. A missed ping suspends rewards; repeated misses anchor it to probation, payouts held for review. The bridge from free registration to paid rewards is live attention: clones awake at once cost operators and machines, so sybil profit falls as clones multiply.
